inventory.scope: template/source population only; no measured execution

capabilityGates.capability: Evaluate macro procedure and invoke closure
capabilityGates.admitCondition: Bind procedure code, evaluator globals and all called capabilities to same admitted context; include caller and callback trace
capabilityGates.refuseCondition: Unknown/replaced expander or effects outside controlled trace; an include-only trace cannot certify it
capabilityGates.remainingClosure: Arbitrary closure bodies cannot be enumerated from these callsites; actual boot definitions must match
capabilityGates.supportAndBenefit: Reuse Scheme macro semantics; add capability/context ownership rather than rewrite expander semantics

capabilityGates.admitCondition: Bind actual eval hooks/environment and all module/effect dependencies before reusable success
capabilityGates.refuseCondition: Unmanaged evaluator replacement, namespace state or native capability; symbol allowlist alone is insufficient
capabilityGates.remainingClosure: Public env choices do not enforce host capability confinement
capabilityGates.supportAndBenefit: Existing evaluator stays; no full purity claim from fresh process or namespace separation

capabilityGates.capability: Load demanded modules, then run code
capabilityGates.admitCondition: Module demand resolver, loaded code and initialization effects belong to same producer/capability closure
capabilityGates.refuseCondition: Unregistered module resolution, initialization, dynamic library closure or unknown load outcome
capabilityGates.remainingClosure: Selected load-modules call is established; complete dynamic resolution caller chain remains open
capabilityGates.supportAndBenefit: Represent required code/groups as managed dependencies; do not omit them from successful trace

capabilityGates.capability: Load native object and register module descriptors
capabilityGates.admitCondition: Only qualified loaded closure with audited initialization and mediated transitive effects
capabilityGates.refuseCondition: Unknown native object, constructor/initialization effects, unresolved dependent library or callback ownership
capabilityGates.remainingClosure: This callable load path is real; its execution by the selected GSC inputs is not established
capabilityGates.supportAndBenefit: Retain loader semantics; qualification requires more than hashing requested object bytes

capabilityGates.admitCondition: Freeze handler table identity and govern handler closure, state and nested capabilities
capabilityGates.refuseCondition: Unknown handler or mutable state not included in producer context; missing callback trace
capabilityGates.remainingClosure: Standard handler installation is reusable support, not a proof about every procedure value
capabilityGates.supportAndBenefit: Use existing reader; shallow table copies do not isolate closure state

capabilityGates.admitCondition: Bind sharp handler, reader parameters and all nested effect answers
capabilityGates.refuseCondition: Unknown sharp procedure or effect bypass, even if source file bytes match
capabilityGates.remainingClosure: All configured reader syntax and callbacks still require coverage
capabilityGates.supportAndBenefit: Standard parser dispatch remains; govern callback entries rather than replacing parsing

capabilityGates.admitCondition: Record exact handler/context and governed callback trace when procedure-valued
capabilityGates.refuseCondition: Dropping comments as semantically irrelevant while comment callback effects are untracked
capabilityGates.remainingClosure: A non-procedure comment setting does not imply arbitrary reader callbacks absent
capabilityGates.supportAndBenefit: Preserve callback behavior; comment-only edits are not universally output-irrelevant

capabilityGates.admitCondition: Admit only when compile feature and actual readtable flag are bound and eval closure is qualified
capabilityGates.refuseCondition: Enabled read-time eval with unmanaged effects; do not assume selected profile enables the branch
capabilityGates.remainingClosure: Both enable-sharp-dot and eval-allowed guard matter; native configured occurrence remains unresolved
capabilityGates.supportAndBenefit: Disabled branch is excluded only with profile evidence; no blanket reader-eval claim

capabilityGates.capability: Call device read/write; retry or wait on errors
capabilityGates.admitCondition: View-bound device/offset/decoder ownership, preserved EOF/error behavior and governed wait/timeout callbacks
capabilityGates.refuseCondition: Live/inherited mutable device, shared offset race, untracked wait callback or unsettled buffered output
capabilityGates.remainingClosure: Port buffering and normal retry logic are visible; full callback/borrow census remains open
capabilityGates.supportAndBenefit: Reuse buffered IO and close paths; add handle/view and completion evidence

capabilityGates.capability: Native read/write/open, raw FD/process and loader entries
capabilityGates.admitCondition: Qualified C ABI/provider and approved transitive capability behavior; use runtime root/VM contracts
capabilityGates.refuseCondition: Unknown native symbol/provider or transitive syscall, inherited capability or unsupervised callback
capabilityGates.remainingClosure: Scheme-level hook coverage is not native FFI closure
capabilityGates.supportAndBenefit: Modern C is core; audited C adapters are required, not forbidden merely for being native

capabilityGates.actualCaller: os_device_stream_read -> device stream virtual dispatch -> file implementation
capabilityGates.capability: Read actual device bytes and errors; POSIX branch calls read
capabilityGates.admitCondition: Bound backend flags, immutable-view handle identity, file position and raw result conversion
capabilityGates.refuseCondition: Unbound backend/foreign device or active unqualified read pump, live fd reuse/alias, missing source/image lifetime or unknown result
capabilityGates.remainingClosure: Read wrapper may take USE_PUMPS non-null read_pump into nonblocking pipe before virtual dispatch; file path requires that branch excluded or governed; device universe remains open
capabilityGates.supportAndBenefit: Retain existing C device architecture; profile-specific virtual dispatch must be qualified

capabilityGates.capability: Native path conversion, device setup, foreign wrapper and cleanup
capabilityGates.admitCondition: Resolved logical namespace maps to image; device and GC/VM lifetime tied to same attempt
capabilityGates.refuseCondition: Live namespace bypass, native pointer escape, failed wrapper ownership not settled
capabilityGates.remainingClosure: C setup/cleanup path is visible; no coherent snapshot issuer implemented here
capabilityGates.supportAndBenefit: Reuse conversion and failure cleanup; snapshot-backed provider is additional support

capabilityGates.capability: Collect C declaration/initialization text for generated artifact
capabilityGates.admitCondition: Include exact text, phase role and ABI/profile in output observation; separately qualify native compile/load phases
capabilityGates.refuseCondition: Do not reject just for C text; reject reusable execution only when an actual unmanaged build-time effect occurs
capabilityGates.remainingClosure: Text collection does not prove any later native initialization effects safe
capabilityGates.supportAndBenefit: Keep C friendliness and existing emitter; distinguish artifact data from executed effects

capabilityGates.capability: Write metadata and C body to same output stream and close
capabilityGates.admitCondition: Attempt-owned staged group, successful close/exit, complete manifest and linearized admission
capabilityGates.refuseCondition: Partial/truncated output, unknown write/close result or publication without success/group custody
capabilityGates.remainingClosure: Normal file close is not transactional group publication; exceptional completion is still open
capabilityGates.supportAndBenefit: Reuse C emitter and syntax; replace scattered success/currentness decisions only after complete caller migration

outputObservations.requiredValue: Exact complete generated C bytes plus logical filename, target/compiler/configured headers/options and group identity
outputObservations.modelCorrespondence: New QNT rawC List[int] is a byte-sequence token under a proved encoding; old bytes:int is only scenario data
outputObservations.fidelityObligation: Prove byte encoding equality and complete consumer context; c-declare/c-initialize are included as bytes
outputObservations.refuseEquality: Same length/sum/hash without collision policy, or equal metadata with changed body
outputObservations.benefitBoundary: Can stop C compilation only when actual bytes and all other compile inputs agree

outputObservations.requiredValue: Accepted first-line marker, full typed Scheme record, compiler/target checks, logical file/flags and ordered input composition
outputObservations.modelCorrespondence: New linkDatum List[int] denotes faithful typed datum encoding plus consumer context; not a field count
outputObservations.fidelityObligation: Prove parser/serializer acceptance and all consumed fields/order; no JSON normalization or symbol/string conflation
outputObservations.refuseEquality: Equal module name or partial metadata while supply/demand, flags, resources or meta-info differ
outputObservations.benefitBoundary: Qualified unchanged link view may stop descriptor/linkfile work despite changed C body

outputObservations.requiredValue: Successful complete group with product role, schema/context, aliases/mode and leased provenance when observable
outputObservations.modelCorrespondence: Artifact role/schema and Receipt success/complete/current are necessary QNT predicates; issuer proof remains external
outputObservations.fidelityObligation: Prove role-specific group completeness and currentness; native module/descriptor/executable products cannot be interchanged
outputObservations.refuseEquality: Existing primary file only, missing side product, mismatched role/context or caller-set true flags
outputObservations.benefitBoundary: Avoid repeat wrappers/existence checks only after one trusted group owner replaces all acceptance paths

outputObservations.requiredValue: Integers and additive oracle intentionally define bounded synthetic behavior
outputObservations.modelCorrespondence: Keep original scenario unchanged; do not force real artifacts into bytes/meta integers or addition
outputObservations.fidelityObligation: Construct a commuting producer relation if transferring that scenario; otherwise use structured observation protocol and an independent oracle
outputObservations.refuseEquality: Length/sum encoding loses ordering; even injective exact integer coding does not prove calculate commutes with GSC
outputObservations.benefitBoundary: Symbolic 0/4/10 counts remain scenario-only, including after exact selected-graph facts

outputObservations.requiredValue: Related actual and clean groups must have equal complete observations; source closures and admission authority separately proven
outputObservations.modelCorrespondence: observationEqualityReflection plus concreteSafetyFromRefinement give only conditional transfer
outputObservations.fidelityObligation: Prove actual clean origin, output fidelity, error/epoch/group reflection, full-budget and capability mapping
outputObservations.refuseEquality: Abstract badReuse=false or current=true without a concrete failure-to-flag/receipt relation
outputObservations.benefitBoundary: Safety, work savings and progress require distinct reflection; no benefit from hiding omitted work

readBoundaries.missingClosure: Configured substitutions and actual boot producer closure are unbound in this template study

readBoundaries.existingSupport: Existing option parsing and wrapper preserve program order
readBoundaries.missingClosure: Actual prelude expansion reads are not a closed trace; pooled compiler global-hook reset not proved

readBoundaries.missingClosure: A callback recording include names misses reader effects, resolved path and other evaluator I/O

snapshotIssueConditions.issueGuard: Coherent namespace/content acquisition; immutable answers and virtual logical path identity; all admitted external writers excluded or serialized
snapshotIssueConditions.failureCustody: Materializer retains storage/view lease on partial acquisition; no live fallback
snapshotIssueConditions.proofTarget: Prove acquisition yields one image, and read adapter preserves names/errors; source currently uses live OS open
snapshotIssueConditions.addedSupport: Source namespace manifest, immutable storage, leases and writer policy
snapshotIssueConditions.retirement: Retire duplicate copy/currentness owners only after all admitted paths route through this issuer
snapshotIssueConditions.benefitBoundary: One image may be shared by 34 generators; does not eliminate their separate semantic reads

snapshotIssueConditions.issueGuard: Exact boot stage/tool closure, target/options/prelude/env/cwd; controlled initial evaluator/reader/hook state; successful or explicitly failed lifecycle
snapshotIssueConditions.failureCustody: Owner retains process and hook/reset responsibility until children, ports and callbacks settle
snapshotIssueConditions.proofTarget: Prove initialization and exceptional cleanup restore/terminate the admitted context; env.begin/end alone is insufficient
snapshotIssueConditions.addedSupport: Typed context fingerprint and fresh/pooled admission policy
snapshotIssueConditions.retirement: Replace repeated ad hoc effective-config interpretation only after parity
snapshotIssueConditions.benefitBoundary: Fresh producer isolates previous mutable state but neither proves deterministic macros nor blocks host effects

snapshotIssueConditions.issueGuard: Every effect influencing requests/output is mediated or explicitly fixed; untracked macro/readtable/native capabilities denied for reusable profile
snapshotIssueConditions.failureCustody: Unclassified effect revokes reusable attempt; retain original failure/result semantics without issuing success
snapshotIssueConditions.proofTarget: Translate admitted Scheme evaluator path to closed ReadProgram; prove all macro and reader callbacks obey capability policy
snapshotIssueConditions.addedSupport: Evaluator/readtable/native capability boundary plus audit trail
snapshotIssueConditions.retirement: An include-only recorder cannot retire conservative host-effect handling
snapshotIssueConditions.benefitBoundary: Can reduce false dependencies only when mediation is complete; tracing overhead remains

snapshotIssueConditions.issueGuard: Required producer validated under same image and stage; complete immutable group; unique committed identity and leased lifetime before dependent read
snapshotIssueConditions.failureCustody: Uncommitted or unknown group remains producer-owned; consumer waits/restarts without consuming stale output
snapshotIssueConditions.proofTarget: Prove producer-before-file-read and append-only group catalogue with conflicting-commit invalidation
snapshotIssueConditions.addedSupport: Group manifests, pending dependency ownership, reader leases
snapshotIssueConditions.retirement: Replace scattered product-existence acceptance only when all concrete consumers migrate
snapshotIssueConditions.benefitBoundary: Metadata cutoff can reuse observations after revalidation; changed bytes still require native object work

snapshotIssueConditions.issueGuard: Successful finite mediated run; ordered answer trace; no unresolved dependency reads/effects; same initial producer context; every consumed answer tied to image/group receipts
snapshotIssueConditions.failureCustody: Failed/unfinished trace is historical diagnostic evidence, not reusable success; leases stay with attempt until drain
snapshotIssueConditions.proofTarget: adaptiveTraceReplay and adaptiveOutputUnique are checked only for the abstract reader; actual translation is open
snapshotIssueConditions.addedSupport: Ordered trace plus dependency/effect completion and failure records
snapshotIssueConditions.retirement: Retire duplicate dynamic dependency recording only after one trace owner covers every path
snapshotIssueConditions.benefitBoundary: Old trace can validate an adaptive branch without rerunning a closed producer; cannot infer closure from no new edges

snapshotIssueConditions.issueGuard: Successful producer exit, complete output group/schema and settled I/O; receipts bind all source and catalogue observations; no outstanding authority borrowers
snapshotIssueConditions.failureCustody: Attempt owner retains staging and borrowed resources on partial failure; no synthetic success
snapshotIssueConditions.proofTarget: Prove source result lifecycle and complete-group custody; current frontend return is not a publication receipt
snapshotIssueConditions.addedSupport: Staging owner, output/schema inventory, process/IO drain
snapshotIssueConditions.retirement: Retire scattered success/exit translation only after complete caller replacement
snapshotIssueConditions.benefitBoundary: Avoid repeated wrapper decisions; no promise of zero validation work

snapshotIssueConditions.issueGuard: Under same issuer linearization authority: source cohort not revoked, dependency receipts current, group complete; publish one manifest pointer
snapshotIssueConditions.failureCustody: Writer first rejects admission; publisher first creates valid historical group later revocable; unknown commit retains single custody
snapshotIssueConditions.proofTarget: Prove writer-before-visibility and admission atomicity imply CutAgreement at commit; epochs/watches alone insufficient

snapshotIssueConditions.retirement: Retire multiple currentness issuers only after no bypass remains

snapshotIssueConditions.issueGuard: Valid successful origin; same producer/context; old ordered requests receive equal answers from new coherent image/catalogue; new admission receipt required

snapshotIssueConditions.proofTarget: receiptBackedAdaptiveReuse is conditional; source mediation and group commit remain open
snapshotIssueConditions.addedSupport: Validated answer lookup and new receipt, even for equal output bytes
snapshotIssueConditions.retirement: Retire timestamp-only dirty propagation when semantic consumers and currentness ownership are qualified
snapshotIssueConditions.benefitBoundary: Input credential invalidation differs from observed output change; full revalidation work must be counted
